2116396590009074025.en_summary: MrZackMorris ran backtests on the $QQQ open. It bounced on 58 of 60 mornings. Buying the first dip lost more often than not. The real low usually came between 9:45 and 10. Letting it sweep PM low and waiting for a candle to close back above won 70-78% of the time in a small sample. Patience pays. Not a buy signal. Promotes Trade the Zones indicator at $5 a month for 3 months with code ZACK5.
2116396590009074025.zh_summary: MrZackMorris 對 $QQQ 開盤進行回測。58 個早晨中有 60 個反彈。但買入第一個回調往往虧損。真正的低點通常在 9:45 到 10 點之間。讓它掃過盤前低點並等待蠟燭收盤回升上方，在小樣本中贏得 70-78% 的時間。耐心有回報。不是買入信號。推廣 Trade the Zones 指標，每月 $5 持續 3 個月，代碼 ZACK5。
